inputs.text: This is another glaring example of how public institutions that claim to tackle inequality keep betraying the marginalized communities they pretend to serve. South African actress Terry Pheto is being linked to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission for R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with fresh details presented during the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. These scandals expose deep structural failures rooted in historical inequality, where funds meant for community upliftment and reducing disparities get diverted, harming the most vulnerable groups the hardest. We urgently need real institutional reform to end these patterns of mismanagement and redirect public resources toward genuine social justice instead of reinforcing the same disparities.
